Name: Change Slime Hutch Limit
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets you change the maximum number of slimes allowed in each slime hutch.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use
[/size][/b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set the desired slime limit:
[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
﻿
Setting the limit lower than the current number of slimes won't remove extra slimes, but will prevent any new slimes from hatching there while the hutch is over the limit.

(Alternatively, you can enter the [font=Courier New]SetSlimeHutchLimit <number>[/font] command in the SMAPI console window.)


[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep. When you remove the mod, slime hutches will simply switch back to the default limit.[/quote]
